description_en: Submits an API in DataService Studio
name: SubmitDataServiceApi

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the DataWorks console. Find your workspace and go to the DataService Studio (https://ds-cn-shanghai.data.aliyun.com/) page. On the DataService Studio page, click the logon username in the upper-right corner and click User Info in the Menu section
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可以登录数据服务 (https://ds-cn-shanghai.data.aliyun.com/)，点击账号名称，查看用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The API ID. You can call the [ListDataServiceApis](~~ListDataServiceApis~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: API的ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780261.html接口获取
parameters.name: api_id

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the API was submitted
Data.description_zh:
提交是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
